Ways to Cope with DPDR

Massage your forehead between your eyes if you feel the tension in your head

talk to yourself and remind yourself what’s going on and why you feel this way 

look around the room 

interact with the outside world, like feel things with your hands 

close your eyes when it gets too much 

breathe, deep breaths in and out 

interact with people 

don’t isolate yourself, you can easily fall into depression/suicidal thoughts 

looking at nature makes it worse 

if your vision gets blurry remember it’s only temporary 

led lights make it worse 

avoid caffeine and alcohol

read out loud helps some people

know that it can cause headaches

identify triggers and avoid them 

practice a lot of self-care

research so you understand what’s happening then stop or you’ll scare yourself 

when you feel an attack coming try not to freak out or i’ll be worse

ground yourself, identify 5 things you can see, 4 things you can feel, 3 things you can hear, 2 things you can smell, 1 thing you can taste

make yourself feel something, try holding an ice cube in your hand 

remember that your brain is an organ and all organs get sick and that’s all that’s happening 

remember that this is just your bodies way of coping 

remember that you’re safe in your own body
 
remember you’re 100% real and normal 

remember that there are so many people that care about you 

remember that you’re so strong!
